note: `include` package names match only the whole package directory under the innermost `node_modules`: `foo.bar` no longer compiles `fooXbar`, `pkg` no longer compiles `@scope/pkg` or `pkg-extra`, names with regex characters such as `foo+bar` are compiled, and dependencies nested in an included package's own `node_modules` are no longer compiled with it. Vite and Rsbuild build the matcher once instead of on every transformed module. No new build errors
